title: Feed Change Watcher output
description: One row per item that had not been returned in an earlier run, plus the report of this run.

newItems.title: New items
newItems.description: One item per feed entry seen for the first time: feed URL, feed title, item id, title, link, publication date and the summary the feed publishes.

report.title: Run report
report.description: Feeds given, feeds read, feeds that failed, new items per source and how many events were charged.
